# Booster Pump P1 — Full Technical Extraction

---

## Section 3: Booster Pump P1

---

### Section 3.1 — Function

- P1 is a **single-stage centrifugal pump**
- Impeller and wear ring wear slowly in service
- Wear effect: **lowers discharge pressure** and **raises motor current** at a given flow
- Pump bearings are **sealed for life**

---

### Section 3.2 — Limits

| Parameter | Value / Condition |
|---|---|
| New pump discharge pressure at rated flow | **4.5 bar** |
| Warning W-31 "Pump performance low" | Discharge pressure below **3.8 bar** at rated flow |
| Alarm A-32 "Pump worn" | Discharge pressure below **3.5 bar** at rated flow |
| Motor current at rated flow — nominal | **3.2 A** |
| Alarm A-33 — motor current | Above **4.5 A** |
| Alarm A-34 — motor temperature | Above **95 degC** |
| Warning W-35 — vibration | Above **4.5 mm/s** |
| Alarm A-36 — vibration | Above **7.1 mm/s** |

---

### Section 3.3 — Service

- Inspect **impeller and wear ring** every **8000 operating hours**
- Expected **impeller life** at rated conditions: **20000 operating hours**
- **Bearing rated life (L10):** **30000 operating hours**
- Operating with **cavitation** (inlet pressure below **0.5 bar**) can **halve impeller life**

---

### Section 3.4 — Troubleshooting

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| **A-32** with **normal filter_dp** | Worn impeller — schedule pump overhaul |
| **A-32** with **high filter_dp** | Replace the **F1 cartridge** first, then re-check |

---

### Error Codes / Warnings — Complete Index

| Code | Type | Description | Trigger Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| **W-31** | Warning | Pump performance low | Discharge pressure < 3.8 bar at rated flow |
| **A-32** | Alarm | Pump worn | Discharge pressure < 3.5 bar at rated flow |
| **A-33** | Alarm | Motor current high | Motor current > 4.5 A |
| **A-34** | Alarm | Motor temperature high | Motor temperature > 95 degC |
| **W-35** | Warning | Vibration high | Vibration > 4.5 mm/s |
| **A-36** | Alarm | Vibration high | Vibration > 7.1 mm/s |

---

### Components Referenced

- **P1** — Booster pump (single-stage centrifugal)
- **F1** — Filter cartridge (referenced in troubleshooting)
- **filter_dp** — Filter differential pressure measurement (parameter used in troubleshooting logic)

# Inlet Cartridge Filter F1 — Full Technical Extraction

---

## Section 2 — Inlet Cartridge Filter F1

---

### 2.1 Function

- Filter designation: **F1**
- Filter type: **20 micron pleated cartridge**
- Operating principle: Particles collect on the cartridge during operation
- Monitored parameter: **filter_dp** (differential pressure across filter)
- Behavior: filter_dp rises with the volume filtered

---

### 2.2 Limits

| Condition | Parameter | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Clean cartridge at rated flow | filter_dp | **0.10 bar** |
| Warning W-21 threshold | filter_dp | **above 0.60 bar** |
| Alarm A-22 threshold | filter_dp | **above 0.80 bar** |

- **Warning code: W-21** — Description: "Filter clogging" — Trigger: filter_dp above **0.60 bar**
- **Alarm code: A-22** — Description: "Filter blocked" — Trigger: filter_dp above **0.80 bar** — Action required: Replace the cartridge

---

### 2.3 Service

**Replacement interval:**
- Every **2000 operating hours**, OR
- Earlier when **alarm A-22 is active**

**Typical cartridge life:**
- At rated flow and normal water quality: **2000 to 3000 operating hours**

**Reduced cartridge life condition:**
- High particle load (example: after mains repair work) — life can shorten to **500 operating hours**

---

### 2.4 Effect on the Pump

- A clogged filter **lowers the pump inlet pressure**
- Critical threshold: below **0.5 bar inlet pressure**
- Below 0.5 bar inlet pressure: pump **may cavitate**
- Effects of cavitation:
  - Raises **vibration_rms**
  - Accelerates **impeller wear**

---

### Cross-Reference Summary — Codes and Parameters

| Code / Parameter | Type | Value / Description |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | Component ID | Inlet cartridge filter |
| filter_dp | Sensor/measurement | Differential pressure across filter F1 |
| W-21 | Warning code | "Filter clogging" — filter_dp > 0.60 bar |
| A-22 | Alarm code | "Filter blocked" — filter_dp > 0.80 bar |
| vibration_rms | Sensor/measurement | Pump vibration RMS — elevated during cavitation |
| 20 micron | Filter rating | Pleated cartridge filtration rating |
| 0.10 bar | Specification | Clean cartridge filter_dp at rated flow |
| 0.60 bar | Specification | Warning W-21 trigger threshold |
| 0.80 bar | Specification | Alarm A-22 trigger threshold |
| 0.5 bar | Specification | Pump inlet pressure cavitation threshold |
| 2000 hours | Specification | Scheduled cartridge replacement interval |
| 2000–3000 hours | Specification | Typical cartridge life (rated flow, normal water quality) |
| 500 hours | Specification | Minimum cartridge life (high particle load conditions) |

# TP-200 Booster Pump Skid - Operation and Maintenance Manual (fictional test machine)

---

## Section 1: Overview

### System Description
The TP-200 skid raises municipal water pressure for a small building.

### Main Components (exactly two):
1. **Inlet cartridge filter (F1)** — removes particles before the pump
2. **Booster pump (P1)** — single-stage centrifugal pump driven by a 1.5 kW motor

### Flow Path:
supply inlet → inlet filter F1 → booster pump P1 → discharge outlet

---

## Section 1.1: Rated Operating Conditions

| Parameter | Rated Value | Permitted Range |
|---|---|---|
| Flow rate | 6.0 m3/h | 2.0 to 8.0 m3/h |
| Inlet pressure | 1.5 bar | 0.8 to 3.0 bar |
| Discharge pressure | 4.5 bar | 3.5 to 6.0 bar |
| Water temperature | — | 5 to 35 degC |
| Duty cycle | continuous | up to 24 operating hours per day |

---

## Section 1.2: Monitoring

**Reporting interval:** once every 10 seconds

### Monitored Channels:

| Channel Name | Unit | Range |
|---|---|---|
| inlet_pressure | bar | 0 to 10 |
| discharge_pressure | bar | 0 to 10 |
| filter_dp | bar | 0 to 2 |
| flow_rate | m3/h | 0 to 12 |
| motor_current | A | 0 to 10 |
| motor_temperature | degC | 0 to 120 |
| vibration_rms | mm/s | 0 to 20 |

### Channel Definitions:
- **inlet_pressure** — inlet pressure in bar
- **discharge_pressure** — discharge pressure in bar
- **filter_dp** — differential pressure across F1 in bar
- **flow_rate** — volumetric flow rate in m3/h
- **motor_current** — motor current draw in amperes
- **motor_temperature** — motor temperature in degrees Celsius
- **vibration_rms** — RMS vibration measured on the pump bearing housing in mm/s

---

## Component Reference Index

| Tag | Component | Type |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | Inlet cartridge filter | Particle removal filter, upstream of pump |
| P1 | Booster pump | Single-stage centrifugal pump, 1.5 kW motor |

## Section 3: Booster Pump P1

---

### Section 3.1 — Function

- P1 is a **single-stage centrifugal pump**
- Impeller and wear ring wear slowly in service
- Wear effect: **lowers discharge pressure** and **raises motor current** at a given flow
- Pump bearings are **sealed for life**

---

### Section 3.2 — Limits

| Parameter | Value / Condition |
|---|---|
| New pump discharge pressure at rated flow | **4.5 bar** |
| Warning W-31 "Pump performance low" | Discharge pressure below **3.8 bar** at rated flow |
| Alarm A-32 "Pump worn" | Discharge pressure below **3.5 bar** at rated flow |
| Motor current at rated flow — nominal | **3.2 A** |
| Alarm A-33 — motor current | Above **4.5 A** |
| Alarm A-34 — motor temperature | Above **95 degC** |
| Warning W-35 — vibration | Above **4.5 mm/s** |
| Alarm A-36 — vibration | Above **7.1 mm/s** |

---

### Section 3.3 — Service

- Inspect **impeller and wear ring** every **8000 operating hours**
- Expected **impeller life** at rated conditions: **20000 operating hours**
- **Bearing rated life (L10):** **30000 operating hours**
- Operating with **cavitation** (inlet pressure below **0.5 bar**) can **halve impeller life**

---

### Section 3.4 — Troubleshooting

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| **A-32** with **normal filter_dp** | Worn impeller — schedule pump overhaul |
| **A-32** with **high filter_dp** | Replace the **F1 cartridge** first, then re-check |

---
